name: @deadragdoll/reactnu
description: React components with a precise DOS-era utility interface.

scripts.build:styles: mkdir -p dist && lessc src/globals.less dist/styles.css && prettier --write dist/styles.css
scripts.build: tsup src/index.ts --clean --tsconfig tsconfig.json --format esm,cjs --external react,react-dom && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && npm run build:styles
scripts.dev: npm run build:styles && tsup src/index.ts --watch --tsconfig tsconfig.json --format esm,cjs --external react,react-dom
